name: Invisible
description:
About This Game

You find yourself aboard an experimental space station that has suddenly malfunctioned.
Your mission is to uncover the cause of the catastrophe, restore control of the station, and return home.

But the path to the control center will be deadly:

In the corridors, terrifying creatures escaped from test tubes and capsules are waiting for you;
the malfunctioning helper robots have turned into ruthless enemies.

You will have to:

  • solve puzzles;

  • search for tools to repair the station’s systems and move further;

  • explore the environment and find safe paths;

  • encounter horrifying creatures and robots — with some it’s better to fight or lure them into traps, while from others it’s wiser to hide in time and run away.

To survive, you’ll have to act lightning-fast:
make decisions on the move, use agility and ingenuity, and most importantly — remain unseen.

Be stealthy. Be invisible.
short_desc: Invisible — the story of an astronaut stranded alone on a space station teeming with terrifying creatures and other dangers. Help D. return to Earth — back home.
